market.question: Named storm forms before hurricane season?

assessment.reasoning: As of late April 2026, no named Atlantic storms have formed in the Dec 4 2025-May 31 2026 window. Only ~5 weeks remain. Pre-season storms occurred in roughly 7 of the last 10 years for any pre-season activity, but the recent trend is closer to 30-40%, and 2026 is forecast to be below-average due to robust El Nino/wind shear conditions. Climatologically May named storms are rare.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a subtropical storm forms in May despite high wind shear environment
